title: Find members who generated income over $40 and also incurred an expense for
question: Find members who generated income over $40 and also incurred an expense for 'Pizza'. Return their full names, phone numbers, and hometown cities.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.XCL_035,
    m.XCL_036,
    m.XCL_040,
    z.XCL_045
FROM member AS m
JOIN income AS i ON m.XCL_034 = i.XCL_029
JOIN expense AS e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.XCL_041 = z.XCL_043
WHERE i.XCL_026 > 40
  AND e.XCL_018 = 'Pizza'
